description: Telegram Mini App payments module (payments/) - Telegram Stars integration, invoice generation, successful_payment handling, webhook, and Mini App HTML checkout page.
steps: Create payments/models.py with SQLite storage: table invoices (id, user_tg_id, amount_stars, description, status, created_at, paid_at, telegram_payment_charge_id), table payment_history (id, invoice_id, user_tg_id, amount, currency, provider, completed_at). Functions: init_db(), create_invoice(user_tg_id, amount, description) -> invoice_id, mark_paid(telegram_charge_id, invoice_id), get_user_payments(user_tg_id).

Create payments/service.py with PaymentService class: create_invoice_link(session, user_tg_id, amount_stars, title, description) -> sends createInvoiceLink via Telegram Bot API with 'XTR' currency (Telegram Stars), handle_successful_payment(update) -> processes successful_payment from Telegram update, validates and records payment, handle_pre_checkout_query(session, query_id) -> answers pre_checkout_query with ok=True.

Create payments/webhook.py with aiohttp-based webhook handler: setup_routes(app) adds POST /webhook/telegram endpoint, parses updates, dispatches pre_checkout_query and successful_payment to PaymentService.

Create payments/mini_app.html - simple HTML page for Telegram Mini App checkout: shows order summary, amount in Stars, 'Pay' button that calls Telegram.MainButton or window.Telegram.WebApp.openInvoice(). Include Telegram WebApp JS SDK script tag.

Add tests in tests/test_payments.py: test invoice creation in DB, test mark_paid updates status, test handle_pre_checkout_query responds ok, test handle_successful_payment records payment, test webhook route returns 200.
acceptance_criteria: payments/ directory exists with __init__.py, models.py, service.py, webhook.py, mini_app.html
python -c 'from payments import PaymentService' imports without error
mini_app.html contains Telegram WebApp SDK script reference
